text:
maria: quick sync — proposing a "lease renegotiation" flow for tiny slab slots (<=4KB) to reduce eviction churn when tenants have short-lived peaks. high level: give objects a bounded grace extension instead of immediate slot eviction, plus a coordinator token to sequence compaction work. RFC draft: https://go/rfc/slot-renegotiate

sam: hmm — can you sketch the main failure modes? what if granting grace causes headroom issues for higher-priority tenants?

maria: good Q. core guards: (1) admission check against priority buckets before granting extension, (2) if admission fails we mark for soft_evict and push reclaim hint, (3) coordinator will rotate compaction tokens to avoid starvation.

kevin: concern: adds RPCs on hot path. can we piggyback on existing offload ACKs or batching ack frames? also we need clear metrics: lease_extensions/sec, forced_evictions/sec, queued_compactions.

jen: I'm +1 on the idea but prefer a bounded retry/backoff: max 3 renegotiations per object per minute and per-tenant opt-in flags. expose as policy.

offload-bot: deploy/plan created: slot-renegotiate-v1 (staging) — https://ci/1234 :rocket:

maria: thanks. adding a tiny pseudo-state and algorithm sketch to the mini-RFC: 
```
LEASE = { owner, expiry_ts, grace_count, priority }
on_renew_request(LEASE):
  if admission_ok(LEASE.priority):
    expiry_ts += GRACE_WINDOW
    grace_count += 1
  else:
    mark.soft_evict = true
```

sam: can you add a local fast-path where runtime can compact up to N objects synchronously when grace_count hits limit? cheaper than whole-slab compaction and avoids RPC round-trips.

maria: yes — plan to offer two reclaim strategies: local-sync compact (threshold N) and scheduled compact via coordinator token (for larger workloads).

jen: @maria add observability hooks: renegotiate_latency, renegotiate_result (granted/denied), renegotiate_fail_reason, and per-tenant counters. also a telemetry tag for "compact_trigger_source" (local vs coordinator).

maria: will add. timeline: update mini-RFC today with sequence diagram + failure cases, get +1 from eng-runtime by EOD, prototype a runtime fast-path next week.

sam: one more: include a safety cutoff that disables renegotiation under global memory pressure (controller signal).

maria: noted. i'll add a global flag and fallback to immediate soft_evict when memory_pressure > THRESHOLD. thanks all :thumbsup:
